240-5295-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5295-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4289-4742-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

529-5641-7175-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

772-3175-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

851-1308-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

475-3263-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3263-4017-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3845-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3249-6586-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-6586-6797.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

67-4050-4053-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

423-573-1437-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1437-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-573-1437-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-5352-7220.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-5352-7220.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Glamermite and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Glamermite and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Glamermite and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Glamermite tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-5352-7220.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Glamermite. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

338-2557-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2557-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

582-851-1409.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

341-2034-4871-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Umori.
Repeat.

4059-7092.easyPrerequisites: The War Doctor does not have summoning sickness.
4059-7092.description:
Cast Dance with Calamity by paying {7}{R}, exiling a number of cards from your library equal to the life total of an opponent.
The War Doctor's first ability triggers once for each card exiled, putting that many time counters on The War Doctor.
Declare The War Doctor as an attacker.
When The War Doctor attacks, its last ability triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the number of time counters on The War Doctor.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-2653-6975.notablePrerequisites: There are at least eight lands between the battlefield under your control and your hand, four or which enter untapped and can tap to produce at least {4}.
1401-2653-6975.description:
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding Multani to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered this way.
Activate at least four lands that enter untapped by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Multani's ability by paying {1}{G} and returning two lands to your hand.
Repeat step 4 at least once, and more times if desired.
Resolve all Multani abilities, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1401-2653-6975.notes: You can repeat step 4 to bounce other lands, but you must bounce lands in multiples of two. All lands bounced this way will be placed onto the battlefield again by Journey to the Oracle.

147-2959.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Heat Shimmer
147-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Heat Shimmer, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

955-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1349-4153-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1339-2122-5231-6627.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-6627.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-6558--39.notablePrerequisites: Naga Fleshcrafter is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-6558--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1698-3260-3540-6259.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-6259.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-6259.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

2523-5147-5401.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

710-2438-2961.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2043-3263-4511-4893.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
 Activate Urza by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Crumbling Vestige that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Crumbling Vestige token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2292-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1110-1407-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to the Tree of Perdition token's power to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

65-717-2628-4607-4652.description:
Activate Smoldering Crater's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Smoldering Crater, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Smoldering Crater trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Smoldering Crater and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
